summary: Independent read-only review accepts H1's exact one-test-only public-controller.test.mjs change for the bounded E1603 compatibility scope. The diff adds one table-driven test with isolated held fixture branches for known transport_failure, outcome_unknown, and successful pending registration. Assertions cover login route/rendered form/enabled submit before and after release, distinct underlying request/result/provider transaction states, no automatic or safe failed/unknown retry, one-call bounds, and ephemeral credential absence in controller/runtime snapshot+inspection/actual PxC Part values/storage/tree before and after separate login validation. The test does not assert global feedback text/style/visibility policy and does not alter controller, app, provider, renderer, or runtime. H1's original focused, full controller, and bounded public-site outputs record 1/1, 56/56, and 14/14. H2 independently reran only the focused table once and observed 1/1 passing. This is compatibility coverage, not a defect fix, global-feedback policy decision, or mounted-browser acceptance.

Each scenario verifies the current login form/submit enabled before and after completion, and registrationCalls remains one. Failed/unknown scenarios execute public:retry and assert nothing_to_retry with no second call. Completion transaction observations are captured before the separate invalid-login control. Secret scan covers controller state, runtime snapshot, safe inspection, actual PxC Part values, volatile storage, and render tree before and after validation; no credential values are emitted.
review.policy_guard: No assertion freezes global feedback wording, status kind, visibility, or CSS. No defect or UI reachability is claimed.
review.disposition_basis: Matches behavior-only regression brief; meaningful future regression coverage with known/unknown/success controls; no implementation defect, unsafe assumption, or scope expansion found.
